title: Tawawa on Monday
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A tired salaryman meets Ai, a large-breasted high school student, on his crowded Monday train; he shields her from the crush and they meet every week, and Wikipedia says he eventually starts a relationship with her. Episodic chapters also follow other well-endowed women, including an office worker and a former student now living with her teacher. This entry is the Weekly Young Magazine manga adaptation of Kiseki Himura's weekly illustrations.
life_message: Small weekly kindnesses can lift a dull life, presented through a frame centered on girls' bodies.
